hypothesis_check.description: H1 / RQ1: the continuous control field should classify a greater proportion of nodes as contested than a Voronoi segmentation, whose contention rate is analytically 0 by construction (every node hard-assigned to one team). Tested over ALL 903 nodes per frame (original definition). Retained for continuity; inflated by nodes far from every player sitting exactly at the neutral 0.5, which falls inside the [0.4, 0.6] contested band by construction — see 'active_footprint' for the primary result.

H1 / RQ1 tested over nodes with (ct_mu + t_mu) > EPSILON only, i.e. nodes within meaningful pre-sigmoid Gaussian influence range of at least one player. This is the primary Metric 1 result going forward — it excludes empty-map nodes that would otherwise be counted as 'contested' purely by sitting at the neutral 0.5 midpoint. Will be all-None until team_agg.py is updated to persist ct_mu/t_mu. The Voronoi baseline remains 0.0 under this restriction too — a hard assignment never lands in [0.4, 0.6] on any subset of nodes.
